diagnosis: All three full-period wealth and fill counts improve on the incumbent, but all drawdowns worsen. The removed-leader pool peak is 2023-04-20 and trough 2024-02-05. The next experiment tests that specific mechanism, not another expansion of the old eight-candidate grid.
